# mxroute_spam_whitelist_entry (Resource)

Manage one shared sender-list entry. One Terraform owner per effective account/list/case-insensitive entry, including across domains, aliases and independent states. Existing entries must be imported. Unrelated entries are preserved. Entry changes replace; case-only edits and access_domain changes do not. Destroy removes only this entry. Import with access-domain/entry; the stored ID is the lowercase entry alone. Cross-state duplicate ownership cannot be detected. Wildcards are encoded once; use a complete domain after @. Runtime behavior is live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mxroute_spam_whitelist_entry" "sender" {
  access_domain = "example.com"
  entry         = "*@example.net"
  # The entry is account-wide. Changing access_domain updates in place.
  # Destroy removes only this entry; unrelated entries are preserved.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_domain` (String) Owned domain used to access shared settings. May change in place within the same effective account. A missing domain is an error, never proof that shared state disappeared.
- `entry` (String) Sender address or pattern; compared case-insensitively. 1–254 documented ASCII characters. Use *@example.net for a whole sender domain; * after @ is not supported by SpamAssassin.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable account-relative identity, independent of access_domain.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mxroute_spam_whitelist_entry.sender 'example.com/*@example.net'
```
